tool.name: Manage LinkedIn Post Engagement
tool.description: Manage audience interactions on LinkedIn posts. Create comments, like posts, or delete comments. Primary tool for two-way engagement and community management on LinkedIn. (Works for both personal and organization posts)

text.description: Comment text (required if action is COMMENT)

actor.description: Optional: Actor URN (person or organization performing the action, e.g., urn:li:person:12345). If not provided, the tool will fetch the current user's profile.

action.description: Type of engagement - COMMENT, LIKE, or DELETE_COMMENT

postUrn.description: Post URN in format urn:li:ugcPost:ID or urn:li:share:ID. The tool will internally derive the activityUrn format needed by the LinkedIn API.

commentId.description: Comment ID (required if action is DELETE_COMMENT)

parameters.args: {{ (() => { const data = lastOutputOf('merge_actor') || lastOutputOf('skip_fetch'); return { postUrn: data.activityUrn, text: data.text, actor: data.actor, object: data.activityUrn }; })() }}
{{ (() => { const data = lastOutputOf('merge_actor') || lastOutputOf('skip_fetch'); return { postUrn: data.activityUrn, actor: data.actor }; })() }}
{{ (() => { const data = lastOutputOf('merge_actor') || lastOutputOf('skip_fetch'); return { postUrn: data.activityUrn, commentId: data.commentId, actor: data.actor }; })() }}

parameters.output: {{ (() => { const comment = lastOutputOf('create_comment'); const like = lastOutputOf('create_like'); const deleteResult = lastOutputOf('delete_comment'); if (comment) { return { success: true, action: 'COMMENT', commentId: comment.body?.id, commentUrn: comment.body?.commentUrn, message: comment.body?.message?.text }; } else if (like) { return { success: true, action: 'LIKE', body: like.body }; } else if (deleteResult) { return { success: true, action: 'DELETE_COMMENT' }; } return { success: false, error: 'No action executed' }; })() }}
